errors.evidence: Description reports MR values of 83.2%, 83.5%, 83.8%, and 84.0% which do not match the figure's actual values of approximately 83.1%, 83.4%, 83.7%, and 83.5%.
The description fails to clearly state the overall purpose of the chart, which is to show average MR values for different parameter levels.
The description does not mention the absence of grouping or stacking of bars, which is a notable visual characteristic of the chart.
